Оборудование: Флуориметр Qubit Реактивы: Набор для флуориметра: Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32851 Оптимизация библиотек для дуплекс-бейсколлинга Для того, чтобы дуплекс-байсколлинг был эффективным необходимо: 1. Следовать протоколу, обеспечивающему успешное лигирование адаптеров к двум концам фрагментов ДНК; 2. Соблюдать рекомендации по степени загрузки ячейки. Недогрузка ячейки приводит к низкому связыванию адаптеров с ячейкой и меньшему выходу секвенирования. Перегрузка увеличивает конкуренцию молекул за пору и снижает вероятность секвенирования обратной цепи. Образцы с широкой представленностью длин фрагментов, например, геномнойДНК начинают с 1 μg материала для подготовки библиотек с использованиемLigation Sequencing Kit или 400 ng для подготовки библиотек с использованиемRapid Sequencing Kit. Для библиотек из коротких фрагментов, например, ампликонов или к-ДНКиспользуют 100-200 fmol материала. Подробный протокол подготовки ДНК к загрузке читайте на сайте Nanopore В реакцию подготовки библиотек со средней длиной фрагмента 800 bp рекомендуется взять по 200 fMol ( 100 ng в 12.5 µL ) ампликонной ДНК. Для этого концентрацию ДНК каждого ампликона нормализовать до 200 fMol.

steps.title: Sample Collection and Field Preparation
steps.instruction: Collect substrate samples from 3 to 5 equidistant points per plot, combining them into a single sterile envelope to ensure community coverage. Store samples in a cooler with refrigerant during transport.

substeps.instruction: Use sterile foil, parchment envelopes, or zip-lock bags for wrapping.
Sterilize gloves and tools with hydrogen peroxide between samples.
Record location, time, and substrate type in a field journal.
Use GPS for geo-referencing each sample.

steps.title: Sample Storage and Pre-processing
steps.instruction: Store samples in a freezer. Before DNA extraction, prepare samples using one of the following methods: freeze-drying (lyophilization to -40 °C under vacuum), drying in a thermal cabinet at up to 40 °C for two days, or processing in a wet state.

steps.title: Substrate Homogenization
steps.instruction: Mechanically grind the dry substrate into a powder using a homogenizer with 250 ml cups. Work under a HEPA filter or humidifier to avoid inhaling fine dust.

substeps.instruction: Cover the sample with sterile foil during grinding to prevent dusting.
Wash the homogenizer cup with a brush under running water, sterilize with hydrogen peroxide, and dry with alcohol and a paper towel between samples.
Transfer approximately 500 mg of the homogenized powder into 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tubes using a sterile spatula.

steps.title: Total DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract total DNA using a commercial kit (e.g., HiPure Soil DNA Kit or SileksMagNA).

substeps.instruction: Soak samples in lysis buffer for several hours at 60 °C in a thermostat.
Perform micro-level homogenization using a manual pestle or a bead-based homogenizer.
Optionally use freeze-thaw cycles to increase efficiency.
Store extracted DNA at -40 °C.

steps.title: DNA Quantification and Normalization
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit dsDNA HS Kit and normalize samples to 5 ng/µL (approx. 10-12 ng in 2.5 µL).

substeps.instruction: Mix 2 µL of DNA with 198 µL of Qubit working solution.
Calculate the required volume of DNA (Vmatr) and nuclease-free water (Vv) to reach the target concentration.
Discard samples with concentrations too low to reach 5 ng/µL.

steps.title: PCR Amplification of ITS Region
steps.instruction: Perform PCR to amplify the ITS1-5.8S-ITS2 region using primers ITS1F and ITS4. Run 2 or more replicates per sample to compensate for stochastic effects.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a reaction mix: 22.5 µL master mix and 2.5 µL normalized DNA.
Run the thermocycler program: Initial denaturation 95 °C (5 min); 25 cycles of 94 °C (30 sec), 54 °C (10 min), 72 °C (elongation time based on fragment length); Final elongation 72 °C; Storage 4 °C.
Verify results via gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: PCR Product Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the ITS amplicons using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.8 volumes of AMPure beads to the PCR product, pipette thoroughly, and incubate for 5 minutes.
Place on a magnetic rack until the solution is clear; discard supernatant.
Wash with fresh 80% ethanol, centrifuge to remove droplets, and air-dry for 1 minute (do not let the pellet crack).
Elute DNA by adding 20 µL of nuclease-free water and incubating for 5 minutes.
Pool replicates of the same sample into a single tube.

steps.title: End Repair and dA-Tailing
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA for ligation by repairing ends and adding dA-tails.

substeps.instruction: Thaw AMPure XP Beads (AXP) and DNA Control Sample (DCS) to room temperature; keep DCS on ice.
Prepare NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Mix and Ultra II End Repair/dA-tailing Module (do not vortex enzymes; mix by inversion).
Reconstitute DCS by adding 105 µL Elution Buffer (EB).
Adjust each DNA sample volume to 11 µL (or 12.5 µL if not using DCS) with nuclease-free water.

Prepare a master mix for N samples: DNA (11 µL), DCS (1 µL), FFPE DNA Repair Buffer (0.875 µL), Ultra II End-prep Reaction Buffer (0.875 µL), Ultra II End-prep Enzyme Mix (0.75 µL), and FFPE DNA Repair Mix (0.5 µL).
Add 3 µL of master mix to each DNA sample, pipette 10-20 times, and incubate at 20 °C for 15 min, then 65 °C for 15 min.
Clean the product: Wash with 200 µL ethanol on a magnetic rack, remove supernatant, and centrifuge.
Perform bead cleanup: Add 15 µL AXP, incubate 5 min, pellet on magnet, and resuspend in 8 µL nuclease-free water. Incubate 5 min.
Final wash: Centrifuge, pellet on magnet, remove ethanol, wash with 700 µL 80% ethanol, and elute 7.5 µL into a clean tube.

steps.title: Barcoding and Ligation
steps.instruction: Attach native barcodes to the DNA fragments.

substeps.instruction: Thaw barcodes (NB01-24) and EDTA; centrifuge and keep on a cold rack.
Prepare the ligation mix in 0.2 mL tubes: 7.5 µL prepared DNA, 2.5 µL Native Barcode, and 10 µL Blunt/TA Ligase Master Mix.
Add EDTA to each tube: 2 µL for colorless cap or 4 µL for blue cap; mix and centrifuge.
Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes (or up to 1 hour, or overnight at 4 °C).
Pool all barcoded samples into one 1.5 mL tube (Total volume: 132 µL for 6 samples, 264 µL for 12, 528 µL for 24).

steps.title: Pooled Library Cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the pooled barcoded library using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.4X AMPure XP Beads to the pooled library; mix and incubate on a rotator for 10 min at room temperature.
Pellet on a magnetic rack and remove supernatant.
Wash with 700 µL fresh 80% ethanol; remove ethanol.
Elute by adding 35 µL nuclease-free water, incubate at 37 °C for 10 min (shake every 2 min), and transfer 30 µL of eluate to a new 0.2 mL tube.

steps.title: Native Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate the native adapter (NA) to the library.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reagents (LFB or SFB, EB, NA, Quick Ligation Buffer, Quick T4 DNA Ligase) on a cold rack. Use LFB for fragments >3kb or SFB for all lengths.
Prepare the reaction in a 1.5 mL tube: 30 µL pooled DNA, 5 µL Native Adapter, 10 µL NEBNext Quick Ligation Reaction Buffer (5X), and 5 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase.
Clean the library: Add 20 µL AMPure XP beads, pellet on magnet, and remove supernatant.
Wash beads with 125 µL LFB or SFB; pellet on magnet and remove supernatant.
Elute by adding 15 µL Elution Buffer (EB), incubate at 37 °C for 10 min (shake every 2 min), and transfer 15 µL of eluate to a new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Library Quantification and Final Prep
steps.instruction: Determine the final library concentration and adjust for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Measure concentration using a fluorimeter.
Dilute the library to 35-50 fmol (simplex) or 10-20 fmol (duplex) in a total volume of 12 µL using Elution Buffer (EB).
Calculate the required volume of library and EB using NEBCalculator.

steps.title: MinION Flow Cell Priming and Loading
steps.instruction: Prime the SpotON flow cell and load the prepared library.

substeps.instruction: Prepare priming mix: Mix Flow Cell Flush (FCF), Flow Cell Tether (FCT), and 5 µL BSA (50 mg/ml). (For vial format: 1170 µL FCF, 30 µL FCT, 5 µL BSA).
Open priming port, remove air bubbles by aspirating 20-30 µL of buffer.
Insert flow cell into the MinION sequencer until it clicks.
Load 200 µL of priming mix into the priming port; ensure liquid flows through the SpotON sample port.
Load an additional 800 µL of priming mix; wait 5 minutes.
Prepare the loading mix in a 1.5 mL tube: 37.5 µL Sequencing Buffer (SB), 25.5 µL Library Beads (LIB) (mix LIB immediately before use), and 12 µL DNA library.
Load 75 µL of this library mix into the SpotON sample port.

steps.title: Sequencing Run
steps.instruction: Configure the software and start the sequencing run.

substeps.instruction: Select the kit, set 'Fast basecalling', and start the run.
Monitor the flow cell: a bright green field indicates a healthy cell; blue indicates unavailable pores.
If temperature exceeds 36 °C or pores are unavailable, stop the run and re-insert the cell.
After the run, close ports and remove 1000 µL of waste liquid.
